an6.46:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahācundo Cetīsu viharati Sahajātiyaṃ.
an6.46:1.3: Tatra kho āyasmā Mahācundo bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an6.46:1.5: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahācundassa paccassosuṃ.
an6.46:2.1: āvuso dhammayogā bhikkhū jhāyī bhikkhū apasādenti
an6.46:2.2: ‘ime pana "jhāyino 'mhā jhāyino 'mhā" ti jhāyanti pajjhāyanti, kiṃ h'ime
an6.46:2.3: jhāyanti, kint'ime jhāyanti, kathaṃ h'ime jhāyantī' ti?
an6.46:2.4: Tattha dhammayogā ca bhikkhū na ppasīdanti, jhāyī ca bhikkhū na ppasīdanti, na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. 3.
an6.46:3.1: Idha panāvuso jhāyī bhikkhū dhammayoge bhikkhū apasādenti
an6.46:3.2: ‘ime pana "dhammayog' amhā dhammayog' amhā" ti uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatī asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākaṭindriyā,
an6.46:3.3: kiṃ h'ime dhammayogā, kint'ime dhammayogā, kathaṃ h'ime dhammayogā' ti?
an6.46:3.4: Tattha jhāyī ca bhikkhū na ppasīdanti, dhammayogā ca bhikkhū na ppasīdanti, na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. 4.
an6.46:4.1: Idha panāvuso dhammayogā bhikkhū dhammayogānaṃ yeva bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, no jhāyīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an6.46:4.2: Tattha dhammayogā ca bhikkhū na ppasīdanti, jhāyī ca bhikkhū na ppasīdanti, na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. 5.
an6.46:5.1: Idha panāvuso jhāyī bhikkhū jhāyīnaṃ yeva bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, no dhammayogānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an6.46:5.2: Tattha jhāyī ca bhikkhū na ppasīdanti, dhammayogā ca bhikkhū na ppasīdanti, na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an6.46:6.2: Dhammayogā samānā jhāyīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsissāmā ti. Evaṃ
an6.46:6.5: Acchariyā h' ete āvuso puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, ye amataṃ dhātuṃ kāyena phusitvā viharanti.
an6.46:7.2: Jhāyī samānā dhammayogānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsissāmā ti. Evaṃ
an6.46:7.5: Acchariyā h' ete āvuso puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, ye gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ paññāya ativijjha passantī
